title: 18 Powerhouse AI Marketing Agencies for Creative and Performance
summary: Compare 18 top AI marketing agencies, from creative-led partners to performance specialists, with the named AI system behind each one.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


AI marketing agencies split into two camps that get confused constantly: creative-led partners that use AI to make more on-brand creative and performance-led shops that use AI to buy and optimize media. We compare 18 leaders across both, from Superside and Monks to Tinuiti and Brainlabs, with the named AI system behind each. **Most enterprises need both, but creative is the bigger lever, so start there.**


AI has become every agency's favorite calling card. But adding "AI-powered" to a capabilities deck doesn't make an agency the right partner for your enterprise.


**The first step is to understand what kind of help you need.** Some AI marketing agencies use AI to produce more creative, faster. Others use the technology to buy media and optimize[creative performance](https://www.superside.com/blog/what-is-creative-performance) . Confuse the two, and you could end up with an impressive partner that does very little to move your brand forward.


In 2026, choosing the right kind of agency also matters more than ever.[Creative demand is up](https://www.superside.com/blog/breakpoint) , many internal teams are at or over capacity, and leadership is pressuring teams to use AI to deliver more high-performing, brand-consistent work faster.


So which agencies have genuine AI capabilities, proven enterprise experience and the infrastructure to deliver standout work at scale?


We compare 18 creative- and performance-led leaders, from Superside and Monks to Tinuiti and Brainlabs. **You'll see what each agency does best, which AI systems power its work and where it fits in the wider marketing landscape.**


You'll also learn why most enterprises need both service types, and which questions quickly separate real AI capability from a polished sales pitch.


## What is an AI marketing agency?


**An AI marketing agency uses artificial intelligence across its marketing services, whether that's creative production and content marketing or paid media and data analysis.**


Rather than simply using standalone AI tools, today's top AI agencies build AI into their creative and performance marketing workflows. As you'll see below, many of the firms on this list have also built proprietary AI platforms with names you can ask to see.


It helps to group AI marketing agencies into two broad categories:


1. **Creative-led AI marketing agencies** use[generative AI](https://www.superside.com/blog/generative-ai-statistics-marketing-creative) to develop and scale concepts, ad creative, video, motion graphics, social media assets and other branded content.
2. **Media- and performance-led AI marketing agencies** use AI, predictive analytics and machine learning to plan and optimize paid media, analyze campaign performance and improve marketing results.


Most enterprise marketing teams need both:[AI-powered creative production to help them scale](https://www.superside.com/blog/scale-creative-production-with-ai) and[creative performance expertise](https://www.superside.com/blog/creative-performance-examples) to reach the right audiences and meet business goals.


## Why creative is the biggest lever in AI marketing


AI has changed how marketing teams understand their customers, produce content and optimize campaigns.


Adoption is already widespread. In[Adobe research with more than 1,600 marketers](https://business.adobe.com/blog/71-percent-of-marketers-say-content-demand-to-increase-5x) , 52% said they use generative AI in multiple parts of their content production process, and 84% planned to use it to support content workflows within the next year.


**Those who use AI well pull ahead.**[Bain & Company reports](https://www.bain.com/insights/generative-ai-in-marketing-five-steps-to-scale-for-real-roi/) that, in its work with leading marketers, content creation time has dropped by 30% to 50% and campaign time to market by up to 50%. Hyper-personalized campaigns have also lifted click-through rates by up to 40%.


But while AI has made the impossible possible, it's also driven demand for creative through the roof. The same Adobe study found that 96% of marketers have seen content demand at least double over the past two years, while 71% expect it to grow more than fivefold by 2027.


As brands produce more personalized campaigns across an ever-growing list of channels and formats, they need a much larger supply of distinctive, on-brand creative. That makes creative production one of the most important levers in any AI marketing strategy.


The effectiveness research is blunt about it. An NCSolutions analysis of nearly 450 sales-effect studies found that creative drives[49% of incremental sales](https://www.westwoodone.com/blog/2025/04/14/marketers-vastly-understate-the-sales-effect-of-creative-and-significantly-overestimate-the-impact-of-targeting-2/) , compared with 21% for brand, 14% for reach and 11% for targeting. Yet when Westwood One surveyed marketers, they credited creative with only 21% of sales impact and ranked targeting first. **Most marketers are underweighting the thing that matters most.**


Kantar's work points the same way. Pairing its ad-testing data with WARC's ROI database, it found that[the most creative and effective ads generate more than four times as much profit](https://www.kantar.com/inspiration/advertising-media/the-art-of-proof-how-creative-quality-drives-profit) as the weakest.


AI can help teams produce, personalize and test more high-quality assets, but a good AI stack alone isn't enough. Brands also need original ideas, strong creative oversight and consistent yet nuanced brand expression. That's where a strong team of creative professionals remains essential.


Our guides to building an[AI creative strategy](https://www.superside.com/blog/ai-creative-strategy-for-performance-marketing) and[maximizing performance marketing](https://www.superside.com/blog/performance-marketing-quality) explore how to pair AI with human oversight, strong creative and good data to set yourself apart.

**This isn't a pay-to-play ranking.** We assessed each agency on its AI capabilities, technical expertise, proven customer work and ability to deliver results. We looked for agencies that build AI into services such as creative production, paid media, data analysis and[marketing automation](https://www.superside.com/service-automation) , with documented evidence of what those capabilities deliver.


Finally, we grouped the agencies into creative-led and media- or performance-led categories to help you find the partners best suited to your immediate needs.

## 18 powerhouse AI marketing agencies for 2026


### Creative-led AI agencies


The following[creative-led agencies](https://www.superside.com/blog/creative-agencies) use AI to produce the content and assets that power marketing campaigns. **If your team needs more high-quality, on-brand creative to keep pace, start here.**


#### 1. Superside


Superside is the world's largest AI-native creative agency, and the clearest example of a company that delivers AI-led creative production at enterprise scale.


We provide a wide range of[creative services](https://www.superside.com/design-services) , from[ad creative](https://www.superside.com/ad-creative) , video, motion and brand to[social media](https://www.superside.com/blog/social-creative-performance-strategies) and[campaign strategy](https://www.superside.com/campaign-strategy-services) , under flexible Flex team, Dedicated team and Custom plans. We provide creative support for 400+ AI-forward brands, and we've delivered more than 200,000 projects, 12,000+ of them AI-powered.


**Our operating layer is what makes us AI-native rather than AI-flavored.** More than 50 proven AI workflows run across briefing, production and QA, and 90%+ of our creatives are AI-certified.[Brand Brain](https://www.superside.com/brandbrain) , the custom, evolving intelligence layer inside our[Superspace](https://www.superside.com/our-technology) platform, keeps every output on-brand as volume scales.


We're also honest about our lane. **Superside does the creative and campaign side of marketing,** ***not*** **media buying, PR or SEO.** That's exactly why we pair so well with the media- and performance-led agencies further down.


Brands like Intuit, Amazon, DoorDash, Figma and Reddit trust us, and independent research shows our AI-native, human-led approach pays off. A[Forrester Total Economic Impact study](https://tei.forrester.com/go/superside/creativeservices/) commissioned by Superside found a 94% ROI and payback in under six months for a composite enterprise organization, whose Superside-powered campaigns generated eight times their production investment, compared with three times without.


- **AI capability:** 50+ proven AI workflows, 90%+ of creatives AI-certified,[Brand Brain](https://www.superside.com/brandbrain) creative memory,[custom AI image models](https://www.superside.com/blog/scale-your-brand-custom-ai-image-models) and[AI excellence](https://www.superside.com/ai-excellence) .
- **Best for:** Enterprises that need on-brand[AI creative](https://www.superside.com/ai-creative) that measurably performs, at scale and across every format.


#### 2. Monks


[Monks](https://www.monks.com/artificial-intelligence) , the operating brand of S4 Capital, is one of the most aggressive enterprise AI-transformation players in the industry. Its proprietary[Monks.Flow](https://monksflow.ai/home) platform threads AI through creative, media and workflow at global scale.


It was also an early mover. Media.Monks was named[Adweek's first-ever AI Agency of the Year](https://www.monks.com/articles/mediamonks-named-adweeks-inaugural-ai-agency-year) in 2023, and Monks offers AI marketing services across brand, social and more for a wide range of industries.


- **AI capability:** Monks.Flow agentic AI platform.
- **Best for:** Global enterprises that want to connect creative production, media operations and performance optimization through AI-powered workflows.


#### 3. DEPT®


[DEPT®](https://www.deptagency.com/) is a global digital agency that describes itself as equal parts creative and technology, pairing creative with proprietary platforms and data. It now leads with[DEPTIFY](https://www.deptagency.com/solutions/deptify/) , its AI orchestration offer for the agentic era.


Its[ADA/DEPT® martech platform](https://www.deptagency.com/service/growth/ada-by-dept-our-all-in-one-proprietary-martech-platform/) draws on data from billions of ads served across thousands of campaigns, and DEPT reports that it helped a leading European cosmetics chain increase online sales by 186%.


[DEPT's work with NVIDIA](https://www.dept.global/case/ai-powered-sign-language-education-that-changes-lives/) shows those capabilities in practice. The team created Signs, an AI-powered sign language platform with avatars, videos and real-time feedback. It earned more than 1 billion impressions with zero paid media, and users learned 20,000+ signs in its first 10 days.


- **AI capability:** AI across design, copy and production, plus DEPTIFY and the ADA/DEPT® platform.
- **Best for:** Global brands that want creative, media, data and technology connected within one digital marketing operation.


#### 4. AKQA


[AKQA](https://www.akqa.com/) is a global design and innovation company within WPP. It combines strategy, design and technology to create brand experiences, digital products and AI-powered services.


Its[AI portfolio](https://www.akqa.com/ai/) includes[Nestlé Goodnes](https://www.akqa.com/work/nestle/nestle-goodnes/) , Nestlé's first direct-to-consumer conversational AI, built in partnership with Microsoft. It also includes Google's[Generative Store](https://www.akqa.com/work/google/bringing-emotion-and-intuition-back-to-online-shopping/) , an AI-powered eCommerce experience that uses Gemini to build personalized store pages in real time.


- **AI capability:** Generative AI experiences on[WPP Open](https://www.wpp.com/en/open) .
- **Best for:** Ambitious brand and product experiences where innovation is critical.


#### 5. Accenture Song


[Accenture Song](https://www.accenture.com/us-en/about/accenture-song-index) is the creative arm of consulting firm Accenture. As one of the world's largest creative groups, it combines branding, customer experience and creative with enterprise consulting, and it deploys generative AI content at scale.


Its[work with Telefónica](https://www.accenture.com/en/case-studies/song/telefonica-kisses-campaign) is a good example. Using its gen AI-powered Content Automation Tool, the team produced more than 300 content pieces in two days, where 40 assets had previously taken several weeks, and the Black Friday creative lifted click-through rates by 249%.


- **AI capability:** Enterprise generative AI content and digital marketing transformation.
- **Best for:** Enterprise programs where creative is part of a broader operating change.


#### 6. VaynerMedia


[VaynerMedia](https://vaynermedia.com/) is an integrated creative and media agency built around the attention economy, with social at the center of everything it does. It uses generative AI across its creative and strategy workflows.


Global brands like Duracell, Meta and Tinder trust it with campaign execution. Its APAC team's[CreAItors](https://vaynermedia.com/vaynermedia-creaitors-ai/) offer shows the AI side in action, generating more than 16,000 storytelling permutations for Grab across six Southeast Asian markets.


- **AI capability:** Generative AI across creative production and strategy, including CreAItors.
- **Best for:** Brands that need social-first creative and integrated media informed by real-time cultural and audience signals.


#### 7. Mekanism


[Mekanism](https://www.mekanism.com/) combines storytelling, audience insight and media through its[Soul & Science](https://www.mekanism.com/soul-science) approach. Its work spans brand campaigns, social content and full-funnel media.


Its in-house[AI Superstudio](https://www.mekanism.com/aisuperstudio) brings together AI content directors, creators, editors, animators and creative technologists, producing AI-assisted multimedia content for social, digital and traditional campaigns.


Full disclosure: Mekanism built that capability with Superside. After a[Superside AI consulting engagement](https://www.superside.com/blog/mekanism) , the agency launched AI Superstudio and reached 85% to 90% AI adoption across the organization in under eight months.


- **AI capability:** An in-house AI Superstudio for generative AI creative development, video production, animation and personalized content.
- **Best for:** Brands that want big campaign ideas supported by fast, AI-assisted multimedia production.


#### 8. Rehab


[Rehab](https://www.rehabagency.ai/) , formerly rehabstudio, is a London-based digital innovation partner for consumer-facing brands, founded in 2005 and known for creative technology work with brands like Google and Spotify.


Its AI arm,[RehabAI](https://www.rehabai.ai/) , builds custom AI solutions that extend organizations' creative capacity across creative, sales and testing. One example is its Cannes Idea Validator, which scored campaign ideas against synthetic personas.


- **AI capability:** Custom creative AI solutions and tools through RehabAI.
- **Best for:** Brands that want bespoke, creative-technology-led AI applications.


#### 9. Omneky


[Omneky](https://www.omneky.com/) offers AI-driven advertising, generating and launching image, video and UGC-style ad variations across Meta, Google, TikTok and other channels, built on brand and performance data.


It's ideal for teams that want to automate ad creative production at scale.


- **AI capability:** AI ad-creative generation at volume, optimized for performance.
- **Best for:** Performance teams that want AI-generated ad variations at scale. Note that Omneky is a tool, not a full creative partner.


### Media and performance-led AI agencies


The agencies below use AI to plan, buy, optimize and measure media. **If your bottleneck is running and optimizing paid media efficiently, start here.**


#### 10. Jellyfish


[Jellyfish](https://www.jellyfish.com/en-us/) , part of The Brandtech Group, delivers media, creative and data for enterprise brands. It works with Brandtech's Pencil generative AI platform, whose enterprise tier, Pencil Pro, was named one of[Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2024](https://www.jellyfish.com/en-us/news/pencil-pro-has-been-named-one-of-fast-companys-mos/) .


[Gentle Monster](https://shareofmodel.ai/stories/gentle-monster-elevates-campaign-performance-with-ai-driven-search-optimization) increased ROAS by 39% after Jellyfish used insights from its[Share of Model](https://shareofmodel.ai/) platform to optimize the brand's Google Performance Max campaigns.


- **AI capability:** Pencil AI creative and Share of Model insights for media optimization.
- **Best for:** Enterprise brands that want to scale AI-assisted ad creative and use AI insights to improve media performance.


#### 11. Tinuiti


[Tinuiti](https://tinuiti.com/) is one of the largest independent performance and media agencies. It manages billions in spend across streaming, Google, Meta and Amazon, specializing in search and performance optimization.


Its proprietary[Bliss Point](https://tinuiti.com/blisspoint/) marketing operating system spans audience, creative, media and measurement. For[illy](https://tinuiti.com/work/commerce-amazon-case-study-illy/) , Tinuiti drove 34% revenue growth on Amazon.


- **AI capability:** Bliss Point measurement and AI-assisted ad tools.
- **Best for:** Brands that need serious performance media management at scale.


#### 12. Brainlabs


[Brainlabs](https://www.brainlabsdigital.com/) is a full-service media agency that uses AI agents, testing and measurement to improve campaign performance.


Its proprietary[Cortex](https://www.brainlabsdigital.com/technology/) platform brings together AI-powered tools for campaign analysis, budget planning and experiment tracking. Its services span AI search visibility, SEO, paid media, analytics and performance creative.


- **AI capability:** Cortex AI optimization platform.
- **Best for:** Data-driven brands that want to optimize media spend through constant experimentation.


#### 13. NoGood


[NoGood](https://nogood.io/) is a growth marketing agency that works with major brands like Nike, TikTok and Amazon. Its services span paid media, content and growth strategy, alongside answer engine optimization (AEO).


It works with[Goodie](https://higoodie.com/) , an AI search visibility platform built by NoGood's founder, to track how brands appear in AI-generated answers and find ways to improve their visibility.


- **AI capability:** Goodie for AI search visibility and AEO insights.
- **Best for:** Growth-stage and enterprise brands that want to improve AI search visibility as part of a broader growth strategy.


#### 14. Single Grain


[Single Grain](https://www.singlegrain.com/) is a full-service digital marketing agency offering AEO, SEO, paid media, creative and content services.


It also implements AI agents and workflows inside customers' marketing operations, using its own products like[Single Brain](https://www.singlebrain.com/) for managed agents and[ClickFlow](https://www.clickflow.com/) for SEO content.


- **AI capability:** AI implementation, managed agents and proprietary marketing tools.
- **Best for:** Teams that want a digital marketing agency that can also deploy and manage AI workflows.


#### 15. Disruptive Advertising


With more than a decade of experience,[Disruptive Advertising](https://disruptiveadvertising.com/) specializes in paid search, paid social and conversion rate optimization.


It uses machine learning in Google Ads and has built custom GPTs that help its teams analyze customer and account data and spot campaign improvements.


- **AI capability:** Machine learning in paid campaigns plus custom GPTs for analysis and recommendations.
- **Best for:** B2B and eCommerce brands that want to improve paid media efficiency and turn more traffic into leads or sales.


#### 16. Directive


[Directive](https://directiveconsulting.com/) is a B2B marketing agency that connects paid media, SEO, content and revenue operations to qualified pipeline.


Its[Stratos](https://directiveconsulting.com/stratos/) platform, available to Directive clients, brings CRM, paid media, SEO and other performance data together to support campaign planning, reporting and budget decisions.


- **AI capability:** Stratos for AI-assisted analysis, reporting and marketing decisions.
- **Best for:** B2B companies with complex sales cycles that need to connect marketing spend to pipeline and revenue.


#### 17. Keenfolks


[Keenfolks](https://www.thekeenfolks.com/) positions itself as an AI-native marketing network for major consumer brands, combining strategy, media and experience with its own AI systems. In March 2026 it launched KEENFOLKS X_, a global network built on its K OS_ operating system.


Keenfolks builds marketing systems for clients, including data centers, content platforms, custom solutions and autonomous workflows.


- **AI capability:** Proprietary integrated AI systems built on K OS_.
- **Best for:** Consumer brands that want an AI-native strategy and activation partner.


#### 18. Omniscient Digital


[Omniscient Digital](https://beomniscient.com/) is a B2B organic growth agency that combines content, SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO).


Its GEO service helps brands improve their visibility and earn citations in AI-generated answers. For[Jasper](https://beomniscient.com/case-studies/jasper/) , it grew organic blog sessions by 810% and blog-attributed product sign-ups by 400x.


- **AI capability:** GEO strategy and execution for AI search visibility.
- **Best for:** B2B brands that want content and SEO to drive growth while building visibility in AI search.


## Creative- or media-led: Which AI marketing agency do you need?


**For most enterprises, the answer is both.** Creative-led agencies produce the content that powers campaigns, while performance media agencies use AI to target, test and optimize them. Some partners, like Superside, also offer[AI consulting](https://www.superside.com/consulting/about) to help connect these capabilities across your marketing operation.


If you have to prioritize, start with a creative-led agency. Even the smartest[media strategy](https://www.superside.com/blog/ai-marketing-strategy) can't compensate for weak creative.


Strong assets give[AI-powered targeting and optimization agencies](https://www.superside.com/blog/ai-powered-agencies) more to work with, which is why many brands keep their media agency and pair it with an AI-native creative agency like Superside. For the creative side of the landscape, our roundups of[AI design agencies](https://www.superside.com/blog/ai-design-agencies) and[ad creative agencies](https://www.superside.com/blog/ad-creative-agencies) go deeper.


## How to choose an AI marketing agency


Whichever camp you're hiring from, these questions separate real[AI excellence](https://www.superside.com/ai-excellence) from marketing spin:


- **What would you take responsibility for?** Ask whether the agency will create campaign assets, manage media, improve performance or handle a defined combination of these.
- **How do you use AI in that work?** Ask for a walkthrough of the tools and workflows the team would use on your account, including what AI does and what people do.
- **Do you have a named system?** A credible AI agency has a specific, named AI capability it can demonstrate, not a vague claim that it "uses AI."
- **Who reviews and approves the output?** Find out who checks creative quality, brand fit and campaign decisions before work goes live.
- **What results can you show from similar work?** Look for relevant examples with clear outcomes, the agency's role and enough context to judge whether the results apply to you.
- **What happens as our needs grow?** Ask how the agency would handle more assets, channels or markets while maintaining quality and turnaround times.
- **What will we pay for, and how will we measure success?** Get clear on fees, deliverables, reporting and the results you'll review together.


## Build your AI marketing team around the work


The bottom line for anyone building an AI marketing agency shortlist is simple. **Separate creative production from media and performance marketing, and hire for both.**


Find a creative-led partner to produce the on-brand creative your channels run on, and a performance-led partner to run and optimize your campaigns. Make sure each one has a real, named AI system that helps you work more efficiently.


If your goal is high-quality, on-brand work at volume with AI built into every step of the creative workflow, Superside is your answer. That's why we sit at the top of the creative-led list.


Being AI-native means AI isn't just powering individual tools. It's embedded across the entire creative model, from how teams are trained to how brand knowledge compounds over time. It's the thinking behind how we pair[AI-native experts with AI systems](https://www.superside.com/human-led-ai-powered) , with real creatives behind every output.

Others, like NoGood and Omniscient Digital, focus on brand visibility across search engines and AI answers. Many enterprises use a creative-led partner and a performance-led partner together.
